angle_en: The twenty-four elements of the field

en.intro: Krishna continues listing the parts of the field, moving from the knower to the known. Listen to the twenty-four elements.
en.notice: Krishna lists the twenty-four elements, including the five great elements, the ego, the intellect, and the unmanifest, that constitute the field.
en.next: Krishna then describes how desire, pain, and consciousness move through this field, bringing its changes to life.
en.meaning: The five great elements, ego, intellect, the unmanifest, the ten senses, the one mind, and the five sense-objects: this is the field in brief.

hi.intro: कृष्ण क्षेत्र के अंगों की सूची जारी रखते हैं, ज्ञाता से ज्ञेय की ओर बढ़ते हैं। इस चौबीस तत्वों को सुनिए।
hi.meaning: पाँच महाभूत, अहंकार, बुद्धि, अव्यक्त, दस इन्द्रियाँ, एक मन और पाँचों इन्द्रियों के पाँच विषय, यह संक्षेप में क्षेत्र है।
hi.notice: कृष्ण इस क्षेत्र के चौबीस तत्वों की सूची देते हैं, जिनमें पाँच महाभूत, अहंकार, बुद्धि और अव्यक्त शामिल हैं।
hi.next: कृष्ण फिर बताते हैं कि इस क्षेत्र में इच्छा, द्वेष, सुख, दुःख और चेतना कैसे आते-जाते हैं, जिससे यह क्षेत्र बदलता रहता है।

en.intro: Krishna continues listing the parts of the field, moving from the knower to the known. Listen to the twenty-four elements.
en.body: The five great elements, ego, intellect, the unmanifest, the ten senses, the one mind, and the five sense-objects: this is the field in brief. Krishna lists the twenty-four elements, including the five great elements, the ego, the intellect, and the unmanifest, that constitute the field. Krishna then describes how desire, pain, and consciousness move through this field, bringing its changes to life.

issues: borrowed: "कृष्ण इस क्षेत्र के मूल को अव्यक्त कहते हैं, जिससे ये सभी तत्व और मन उत्पन्न होते हैं।" (The notice presents content from the NEXT verse (7), which describes desire, pain, and consciousness moving through the field, as if it were part of this verse. The current verse (6) simply lists the 24 elements of the field, and does not describe the unmanifest as the root from which elements and mind grow.)
